phase: Supercruise arrival + mode restructure. Split the single F flight toggle into TWO independent buttons: E = supercruise DRIVE on/off (engage / drop-out, anytime, pose-preserving), F = FLIGHT CONTROLS on/off (hands-on piloting <-> latched free-look). Three player modes: Toybox (orbit/examine, Esc/menu), In-Flight (E enters; drive + controls layers), and the autopilot/assist that rides the same ShipControls surface (Autopilot=tour=screensaver picks targets; Assist=player picks via free-look-aim or nav computer). Reuse ShipChoreographer for asymmetric enter(swell)/drop(jolt) camera-shake FX. 'SAFE TO DROP' (_scDropState, exists) becomes guidance, not a gate. Anti-clip = gravity-well speedCap (no damage/penalty system). Fix the Assist moving-moon (Dione) ALIGN hang. Supersedes the 2026-06-25 F=ON/OFF decision; pose-preserving drop avoids the body-center re-anchor bug that forced the old drop-out removal. Builds on feature/supercruise-freelook. Out of scope: render-FX (streak/whoosh/FOV), normal-space flight model, hull/damage, min-speed floor, world-origin rebasing, NPC ships, SC_TUNING floor re-tuning.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The supercruise drive toggle behaves correctly at the model level: engaging accelerates the ship along its nose toward the gravity-well-capped cruise speed; dropping out idles the drive while PRESERVING momentum (no instant zero); re-engaging while the nose vector points into a body cannot exceed ~0 speed (gravity-well anti-clip); pointed away, it accelerates normally.

verifyVia.input: Headless Vitest: step the model through engage -> cruise -> drop-out -> re-engage near a body vs in open space; engage with the nose toward a body vs away.
verifyVia.observable: Speed asymptotes to the gravity-well cap on engage; on drop-out, speed decays from its prior value (not snapped to 0) and position keeps advancing on residual momentum; engage-toward-body keeps speed ~0 (capped); engage-away accelerates.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Latched free-look routes look input to the head mount and freezes the virtual joystick; toggling it off eases the view back to center-on-nose within tolerance; the ship's trajectory is identical with and without free-look input (free-look writes only the camera).

verifyVia.input: Headless: fly a fixed trajectory while applying free-look input through the latched flag; toggle off; sample ship heading/trajectory and head yaw/pitch.
verifyVia.observable: Ship position+heading series bit-identical with vs without free-look input; head yaw/pitch diverge while latched and ease to ~0 after toggle-off (centered).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Pressing E to drop out of supercruise is pose-preserving at any world-origin drift: the camera world position and orientation are unchanged across the drop, the drive idles, and you stay In-Flight (not Toybox). Re-engaging resumes; aimed into a planet you cannot accelerate in.

verifyVia.input: Live (GPU :9223/:5174, testing-ref §6.5 camera world transform): fly to drift the origin, drop out (E) at several positions incl. near a planet, measure camera transform pre/post; re-engage aimed at vs away from the body.
verifyVia.observable: dPos ~= 0 and quatDot ~= 1 across the drop (no snap, scaled-drift-safe); drive idles (speed decays/parked); re-engage-toward-body stays ~0 speed, re-engage-away accelerates; 0 new console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The mode machine works live: E from Toybox enters In-Flight and engages the drive; F toggles free-look (click+drag moves the camera, the ship keeps moving, re-grab eases to center-on-nose); Esc exits In-Flight to Toybox with no snap; selection persists appropriately across transitions.

verifyVia.input: Live: from Toybox press E; in flight press F (drag camera) then F again; press Esc; observe camera + selection through each transition (camera world transform).
verifyVia.observable: E enters flight + drives; free-look swings the camera while ship trajectory continues, recenter on re-grab; Esc returns to Toybox orbit with dPos/dQuat ~ no snap; reticle/selection behaves per design; 0 console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Assist flies the player to a chosen destination from either target source: aiming at a body in free-look and selecting it, or selecting via the nav computer, then committing (Space) flies throttle+steering there and parks; any manual input cancels the pilot.

verifyVia.input: Live: in free-look aim at a body, select, Space; separately select via nav computer, Space; then inject manual W/S mid-flight.
verifyVia.observable: Pilot flies to the target and parks (SAFE TO DROP shows in-window at arrival); both target sources work; manual input cancels the pilot (takeover), no snap.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The autopilot tour (screensaver) is unaffected: Q tours bodies via the controls; free-look works during the tour; the unattended loop (warp -> arrival at billboard distance -> tour -> auto-warp) still completes across systems.

verifyVia.input: Live: Q tour through >=2 stops + free-look during it; let the loop run a full system visit + auto-warp.
verifyVia.observable: Tour flies + visits bodies via the supercruise model; free-look swings view without disturbing the tour; auto-warp completes with the star in billboard LOD; no new console errors; Toybox + mobile constraint untouched.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Enter/exit camera-shake FX are present and asymmetric: engaging supercruise (E) produces an acceleration swell; dropping out (E) produces a sharp jolt; the shake is rotation-only (no camera position displacement).

verifyVia.input: Live: engage then drop out; sample the camera transform + shake driver state across both.
verifyVia.observable: Engage shows a swelling rotational beat, drop shows an impact-then-ring beat (distinct envelopes); camera POSITION unchanged by shake (rotation-only invariant); the beats are visible but not nauseating.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Assist converges on an orbiting moon (e.g. Dione) without hanging or flipping its target within a bounded time (the ALIGN throttle-0 dot gate no longer stalls against a moving target).

verifyVia.input: Headless unit: ALIGN against a moving target whose position advances each step. Live: engage Assist on a moon and time convergence.
verifyVia.observable: ALIGN proceeds (leads the target / relaxes/timeouts the dot gate) and CRUISE begins; live convergence on a moon completes within a bounded time with no target flip.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Flying it reads right as a cohesive whole: E drops you in/out of supercruise cleanly with no snap, F free-look feels good and keeps your momentum, reaching a planet feels like an arrival (jolt + park), Assist takes you where you point/select, the autopilot still showcases the system, and Toybox still orbits-and-examines.

verifyVia.input: Max flies: drops in/out, free-looks while cruising and while parked, flies to a planet manually and via Assist, aims+selects in free-look, watches the autopilot tour, switches to Toybox.
verifyVia.observable: Holistic acceptance — does this cohere as the arrival + mode experience Max wanted. Deferred to Max.
